explanation: It was centred on Benin City, in southern Nigeria. The Republic of Benin, to the west, took its name in 1975 from the Bight of Benin, a bay named after the kingdom.

claims.text: The historical Kingdom of Benin, famed for its brass plaques, was centred on Benin City, in modern Nigeria.
The Kingdom of Benin was not centred in the modern Republic of Benin, in Ghana or in Cameroon.
The Republic of Benin, formerly Dahomey, took its name in 1975 from the Bight of Benin.
The Bight of Benin is named after the Kingdom of Benin.
